. CATHEDRAL OF THE ASSUMPTION: “RAISE THE ROOF” LOTTO INITIATIVE Weekly Lotto Draw Results November 19th: Winning Numbers 14; 18; 27; 28. The Jackpot was not won. Cash Prize of €50 to the weekly winner. – Marie White, Thurles. Next Draw: November 26th - Jackpot: €13,375.00 For the Christmas Season the weekly Lucky Dip will increase to €150 for the four draws before Christmas commencing with Thursday December 3rd Draw. We are deeply grateful to all who have supported to date our fundraising drive for the Cathedral Reroofing Project –- We are delighted to inform you that we now have exceeded 1.8 million! A big Míle Buíochas to all who are supporting this project. The lotto has assisted immensely in reaching the €1.8 million of the €2.5 million required for us to commence the Reroofing of our Cathedral. Thank you!‘IN OUR HANDS: PRESERVING OUR CATHEDRAL’ Having now commenced Phase 2 of our fundraising cam paign which we hope will get us to the magic figure of €2.5 million. “In Our Hands: Preserving Our Cathedral” is a fundraising campaign that we hope will encourage people, near and far, to support the reroofing project by donating towards the cost of the slates. Our objective is to have all the necessary works to this magnificent building completed in time for the 150th anniversary of the Cathedral’s construction in 2029. You can purchase a slate or a bundle of 4 – a symbolic and practical way to help reroof the Cathedral. Let us preserve our sacred Cathedral, protect its rich history and ensure it continues to inspire for generations to come! Visit

for more information.
